text:
nina: New onboarding sample is flaky on physical devices when using `adb reverse` -> small local HTTP proxy that rewrites TLS -> HTTP. On-device the Retrofit call never completes; server shows the request arrived but the socket stays open and no response is sent.

nina: Stack shows thread stuck in okhttp3.internal.http.RealCall.getResponseWithInterceptorChain -> Exchange.finish -> blocked. No 401, no retry. Emulator is fine.

rob: That pattern screams proxy / protocol downgrade race. If client starts an HTTPS request but proxy rewrites to HTTP locally you can hit ALPN/HTTP2 negotiation mismatches. Which OkHttp/Retrofit versions?

nina: OkHttp 4.11.0 + Retrofit 2.9. App uses default client. Repro: `adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080` + run sample + call /health -> hangs.

kevin-m: Quick checks: 1) force `Protocol.HTTP_1_1` to disable http2, 2) try `.connectionSpecs(Collections.singletonList(ConnectionSpec.CLEARTEXT))` for the proxy path, 3) set explicit `callTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)` to avoid indefinite hangs.

rob: Also test disabling connection pooling in sample: `new ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)`. If that changes behavior it points to stale sockets being reused across the proxy rewrite.

nina: I tried callTimeout=20s -> now client returns after ~20s with EOFException. So proxy is closing mid-exchange. Pool tweak didn't help. Forcing HTTP/1_1 eliminated the hang and request completes quickly.

kevin-m: Good repro. Likely OkHttp attempts HTTP/2 or h2 prior knowledge and the proxy rewrite breaks the upgrade path. For onboarding docs we should recommend forcing HTTP/1.1 when using adb/local proxies or advise against TLS->cleartext proxying.

rob: Another runtime detection idea: sample can detect common adb proxy signs and warn users. Check `System.getProperty("http.proxyHost")` or `ProxySelector.getDefault()` and print a warning: "Detected device proxy/adb reverse; prefer direct https or run without proxy."

nina: I'll add a runtime warning and a short section in the onboarding docs. But we should also add a tiny two-file repro (APK + python proxy) to the DX repo so support can reproduce on-device.

kevin-m: For SDK parity tests add a device-only matrix step that runs sample with and without `adb reverse` and checks for hangs. Also add a unit test that asserts `client.connectionSpecs` includes CLEARTEXT when using local proxies in samples.

rob: Upstream issue: if we can capture a packet trace showing ALPN/SETTINGS being ignored or a GOAWAY from proxy, we can open an OkHttp ticket. If we can't reproduce outside adb proxy, file it as "adb-proxy-induced HTTP/2 downgrade path".

qa-bot: CI run created: https://ci.internal/repro/1749999999-proxy-hang-1 (device: Pixel6 API 33). Logs attached.

nina: Thanks 44d I'll push a small PR: 1) sample code: force Protocol.HTTP_1_1 when `DETECT_ADB_PROXY` flag is true, 2) onboarding docs: add section "ADB/local proxy caveat" with suggested workarounds, 3) add repro artifacts + CI job.

kevin-m: One more note for docs: recommend `callTimeout` and `retryOnConnectionFailure(false)` for uploads in sample apps when running under proxies so the user sees a clear error instead of default retries.

rob: Agreed. Also add a snippet to detect proxy and print an actionable troubleshooting message (example below).

rob: ```java
String proxy = System.getProperty("http.proxyHost");
if (proxy != null) {
  Log.w("sample", "Detected device proxy. For best results run sample without adb reverse or use HTTPS end-to-end.");
  okHttpClient = okHttpClient.newBuilder().protocols(Collections.singletonList(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)).build();
}
```

nina: Great, patch incoming. We'll keep the forced HTTP/1_1 change behind a dev flag so production SDKs are unaffected.
